title: The Ethical question about the trial
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：ethical　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ethical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the director wrote of ① an ethical question about the trial in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② so ethical that nobody in the theatre would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the ethical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the ethical question about the trial that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ethical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the ethical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ethical rule for the lab, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ethical as the rule for the lab they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ethical or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ethical, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite ethical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the ethical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, in public, she wrote of another ethical question about the trial in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less ethical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The ethical rule for the lab that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the ethical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 道德（前置定语 an ethical question about the trial：1952 年导演在戏报里记下的那件道德的问题）
B. adj. 道德／合乎伦理（两处加强说法：so ethical that … 与 no less ethical than …）
C. adj. 道德／合乎伦理（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 道德（表语 too ethical to do：母亲觉得它太道德，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 合乎伦理（前置定语 an ethical rule for the lab：叔叔把整件事称作一桩合乎伦理的伦理准则）
F. adj. 合乎伦理（同级比较 as ethical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩实验室的伦理准则相比）
G. adj. 合乎伦理（后置定语 something ethical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 合乎伦理（受程度副词修饰 quite ethical：那位演员的评价）

items.q: an ethical question about the trial
the ethical question about the trial that
an ethical rule for the lab
The ethical rule for the lab that

answers.why: ethical 意为“道德”，1952 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件道德的问题”，此处作前置定语 an ethical question about the trial。
ethical 意为“道德”，此处用 so ethical that 结构，说它道德到戏院里没人敢靠近。
ethical 意为“道德”，戏报上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的道德试验引发的道德问题，等于最高级的说法。
ethical 意为“道德”，母亲认为这件东西“太道德了，谁也用不上”，too ethical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩合乎伦理的伦理准则”，此处作前置定语 an ethical rule for the lab。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩实验室的伦理准则一样合乎伦理”，同级比较用 as ethical as。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，戏报上那半行字要的是“合乎伦理的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ethical。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当合乎伦理”，quite 修饰原级 ethical。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，no less ethical than 表示“其合乎伦理不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之合乎伦理不亚于任何人的预料。
ethical 意为“合乎伦理”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的合乎伦理伦理准则”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件道德的问题。（an ethical question about the trial）
它道德到戏院里没有一个人敢靠近。（so ethical that …）
母亲觉得它太道德，谁也用不上。（too ethical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩合乎伦理的伦理准则。（an ethical rule for the lab）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩实验室的伦理准则一样合乎伦理。（as ethical as …）
到了 1959 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件合乎伦理的东西。（something ethical）
answers: In 1952 the director wrote of an ethical question about the trial in the poster.
It was so ethical that nobody in the theatre would go near it.
My mother thought it too ethical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ethical rule for the lab.
He said nobody would call it as ethical as the rule for the lab they had once had.
By 1959 the poster asked for nothing but something ethical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ethical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the director wrote of an ethical question about the trial in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the ethical question about the trial that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too ethical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ethical rule for the lab, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite ethical, and everybody laughed.
The ethical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
